control_plans.request: Transform the train into a futuristic sci-fi train with titanium panels, glowing blue light strips, and sleek rooftop power modules. Upgrade the surroundings to a futuristic urban transit hub with cinematic lighting and realistic reflections. Preserve the train’s motion, window layout, and camera movement.

input.prompt:
Transform the entire scene into a photorealistic futuristic urban transit hub. Replace the background shops with a glass-and-titanium station concourse, sweeping platform canopies, blue information displays and modern towers rising above the train. Replace foreground asphalt with dark polished transit paving containing recessed blue guide lights. Transform the striped crossing barrier into a sleek metallic safety rail following its original position. Warm cinematic sunlight and cool architectural lights produce grounded shadows and realistic reflections across paving, glass and metal.

Resurface the moving train with precision-fitted brushed titanium panels and crisp seams. Replace its orange bands with narrow glowing electric-blue strips. Replace existing rooftop equipment with sleek low-profile titanium power modules featuring recessed blue illuminated vents.

Preserve the original window layout throughout: retain every passenger window, cab window, mullion and door pane in its original position, shape and dimensions. Each double door keeps two separate small upper glass panes and solid lower metal panels. Keep solid body sections solid; fit titanium around the existing openings. Retain passengers, carriage joints, wheels and train proportions. Preserve the source's leftward train motion, speed, carriage progression, camera movement and framing throughout the continuous shot.

payload.prompt:
Complete this futuristic transit scene. Replace the ordinary buildings behind the train with a coherent glass-and-steel station: the shop at the left becomes a glazed entrance with luminous blue information displays; the pitched rooftops above the train become an elevated glass concourse with sculpted metallic supports. Replace overhead utility wires and poles with clean architectural transit gantries. Keep this architecture behind the moving train, leaving its roof visible. Carry the station design across the entire background throughout the shot.

Replace every white rooftop ventilation box with a smooth, low-profile graphite-and-titanium power module, with recessed electric-blue cooling slots. Retain the brushed titanium train body and add thin continuous blue luminous strips along the existing horizontal body seams below the passenger windows. Keep the blue accents narrow and precisely integrated.

Retain the metallic foreground safety rail. Give the surrounding transit paving crisp blue inset guide lights and subtle realistic reflections. Use cinematic late-afternoon sunlight, warm metallic highlights, cool station illumination and grounded shadows. Reflections of the station move naturally across the passing titanium panels without smearing.

Preserve the input train's window layout, individual mullions, paired small upper door panes, solid lower door panels, visible passengers, carriage connections and proportions. Preserve the original leftward motion, speed, carriage progression, camera movement and framing in one continuous shot.
